positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Channel Marketing Division (2010-present):

I work closely with marketers across several of Intuit’s business units to implement promotions, cross-sells, and marketing pages on many of Intuit’s sites and properties, including QuickBooks Desktop, QuickBooks Online, Intuit Payroll, and Intuit Websites.  This includes front-end development of landing and marketing pages and back-end development of logic for targeting and recommendation engines.  I have also utilized web optimization testing and analytics suites such as Adobe Test&Target and SiteCatalyst.  

Intuit Websites Division (2008-2010):

I developed for and maintained the account creation and "first-time-use" demonstration flow.  I also co-developed the “PhotoGallery” element in the “SiteBuilder” website development program, allowing users to easily add a Javascript Lightbox modal dialog image gallery to their site via a drag-and-drop element and a UI to upload images to the “PhotoGallery” element.
